reason: It's a brand-new brand with no reviews and no lab results I can see, and I'm not dropping $68 plus a subscription on the word of one creator. I'd rather spend a bit less on a filter bottle that has thousands of reviews.
objection: How do I know the filter actually does anything? There's no independent test or certification mentioned, just the supplier's 150 L rating.
would_change_my_mind: Published third-party lab test results (e.g. NSF certification) plus a few hundred real customer reviews.
